parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - System Health Monitoring & Alerting (PET WF15)

**🎯 Purpose:** Comprehensive system health monitoring with automated failure detection and multi-channel alerting

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Continuous Health Monitoring:**
• **Hourly System Checks:** Automated monitoring of all critical business systems
• **Multi-Service Monitoring:** Tracks booking system, SMS service, and data integrations
• **Response Time Tracking:** Monitors API response times and service availability
• **Timeout Detection:** Identifies systems that are slow or unresponsive
• **Status Code Analysis:** Analyzes HTTP responses for service health

**Intelligent Alert System:**
• **Tiered Alert Levels:** INFO, WARNING, and CRITICAL based on impact severity
• **Multi-Channel Notifications:** Email + Telegram alerts for immediate attention
• **Smart Alert Logic:** Only sends notifications when intervention is required
• **Impact Assessment:** Analyzes business impact of system failures
• **Professional Formatting:** HTML email alerts with system status dashboard

**Comprehensive Logging:**
• **Health History Tracking:** Complete log of all system health checks
• **Trend Analysis:** Historical data for identifying patterns and recurring issues
• **Performance Metrics:** Response time and availability tracking over time
• **Alert Audit Trail:** Records when alerts were sent and system status changes

**⚡ Automated Monitoring Process:**

**1. Hourly Health Checks:**
- **Booking System API:** Tests appointment system availability and response time
- **Twilio SMS Service:** Verifies SMS notification capability and API access
- **Google Sheets Integration:** Confirms data logging and spreadsheet access
- **Timeout Handling:** 10-second timeout for each service check

**2. Health Analysis Engine:**
- **Status Evaluation:** Determines individual system health based on response codes
- **Overall Health Calculation:** Computes clinic-wide system health percentage
- **Alert Level Assessment:** Categorizes issues by severity and business impact
- **Impact Analysis:** Identifies which clinic operations may be affected
- **Trend Detection:** Compares current status with historical performance

**3. Intelligent Alerting:**
- **Critical Alerts:** Immediate notification when multiple systems fail
- **Warning Alerts:** Proactive notification for single system failures
- **Professional Formatting:** HTML emails with status dashboard and details
- **Telegram Integration:** Instant mobile notifications for urgent issues
- **Alert Suppression:** Prevents spam by only alerting on status changes

**4. Data Logging & Reporting:**
- **Health Check Database:** Permanent record of all system monitoring results
- **Performance History:** Response time trends and availability statistics
- **Alert History:** Complete audit trail of all notifications sent
- **Business Continuity:** Data for assessing system reliability and planning

**📊 System Monitoring Coverage:**

**Booking System Monitoring:**
• API endpoint availability and response times
• Appointment scheduling system functionality
• Online booking form accessibility
• Integration with clinic management software
• Customer-facing booking interface health

**Communication System Monitoring:**
• Twilio SMS API connectivity and authentication
• SMS delivery capability and account status
• Message queue processing and delivery rates
• Phone number provisioning and service status
• International messaging capability (if applicable)

**Data Integration Monitoring:**
• Google Sheets API access and authentication
• Spreadsheet read/write permissions and connectivity
• Data synchronization between systems
• Backup and recovery system accessibility
• Third-party integration health checks

**🚨 Alert Response Framework:**

**CRITICAL Level (Multiple Systems Down):**
• Immediate email + Telegram notification
• Business owner and IT contact notification
• Escalation procedures for extended outages
• Emergency contact activation if needed
• Client communication preparation

**WARNING Level (Single System Issue):**
• Email notification with impact assessment
• Telegram alert for mobile awareness
• Recommended action items and troubleshooting
• Monitoring frequency increase for affected system
• Backup procedure activation if available

**INFO Level (All Systems Healthy):**
• Routine logging without immediate alerts
• Historical data collection for trend analysis
• Performance baseline establishment
• Preventive maintenance scheduling
• System optimization opportunities

**🔄 Integration Points:**
• Booking System: {{BOOKING_SYSTEM_API_URL}}
• Twilio SMS: Account {{TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID}}
• Google Sheets: {{MASTER_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_ID}}
• Health Logs: {{SYSTEM_HEALTH_LOG_SHEET_ID}}
• Alert Channels: {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}} + {{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Schedule: Every hour, 24/7
• Timezone: {{TIMEZONE}}
• Alert Format: HTML Email + Telegram
• Monitoring Depth: 3 critical business systems
• Response Timeout: 10 seconds per check
